objective: Gate 16D: implementar el SDK proveedor-neutral del Universal Cavas Connector, exclusivamente como contrato puro de adapters sobre el Migration Engine certificado en 16C. Debe definir capacidades, contexto por referencia de conexion, health, full/delta extraction, checkpoints, validacion de instancia y manifest. Sin resolver conexiones, sin secretos, sin SQL, sin adapters de proveedor concretos, sin endpoints ni Scheduler.
constraints: No provider-specific adapter implementation in this gate
No second connection registry or credentials store
Connection reference only; actual resolution remains canonical EDARSAHUB infrastructure
No SQL DDL/DML or SQL connection
No secrets in adapter context or manifest
